以街口为起终点，选一小段 Jackson Street 看店面和街区细节；想进历: Start and finish near the intersection, exploring a short stretch of Jackson Street. Check separate museum hours and admission if you want to go inside. Return to your pickup point or Japantown/Ayer station.
The Tech 的 $5 停车验证只适用于官网列出的 Convention C: The Tech’s $5 parking validation applies only at the listed Convention Center and 2nd and San Carlos garages. Bring your ticket inside for validation; it does not apply when special-event parking rates are imposed. Japantown needs its own parking plan. For visitors sensitive to noise, darkness or crowds, review the sensory guide and choose experiences they can leave comfortably; nobody has to finish an IMAX screening.
